dictionaryQualification: Actual relevant senses were read. 長い restricts physical length to 長, while duration allows 永. 日本語 has にほんご and にっぽんご. 静か/閑か, 綺麗/奇麗/キレイ, 話す/咄す, 座る/坐る and 壊れる/毀れる are retained in fitting contexts. 滑る is the supplied すべる slipping verb, not the distinct ぬめる lemma or a Go-game meaning. 読み方/仕方/使い方 entries corroborate method nouns; 使い方's management sense is not scored. The good-quality noun entry lists 良さ/好さ/善さ; the person's merits context supports that noun, not every spelling of an unrelated adjective use. Other local prompt glosses are author-reviewed, not individually dictionary-verified.
spellingScope: Ease/difficulty tasks visibly request the displayed hiragana suffix, including づらい. JMdict also registers ずらい; it is outside this named spelling operation, not declared universally ungrammatical. Daijisen gives the づらい suffix; the official kana Part 2 provides general compound-voicing rules but does not explicitly list this suffix. The irregular いい-to-adverb task visibly requests hiragana to test the ii-to-yo stem operation. Other recognized fitting base/method spellings share one response class; recognition does not imply equal frequency.
